questions.question: Calculate the total voltage of three 1,5 V cells in series, and of three 1,5 V cells in parallel.
questions.expected_answer: Series: 1,5 + 1,5 + 1,5 = 4,5 V. Parallel: 1,5 V (same as one cell).

questions.question: Compare the brightness of a bulb and how long the cells last for two identical cells in series and two in parallel.
questions.expected_answer: Series: 3 V, so the bulb is brighter, but the cells run down faster. Parallel: 1,5 V, so the bulb has normal brightness, but the cells share the current and last longer.

questions.question: Explain how to connect a voltmeter to measure the voltage across a bulb, and why a torch with one cell reversed may not light.
questions.expected_answer: Connect the voltmeter in parallel, one lead to each end of the bulb (positive lead to the side nearer the positive terminal). A reversed cell pushes against the others, so its voltage subtracts and the total voltage is too small.
